itens.titulo: Amazon stock pops after Morgan Stanley details 5 catalysts, lifts price target
itens.descricao: Amazon stock pops after Morgan Stanley details 5 catalysts, lifts price target Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: Amazon (AMZN) stock rose as much as 5% on Monday after Morgan Stanley named it a top pick and raised its price target to $350 from $335, outlining five catalysts that could drive the stock higher.
The new target implies about 40% upside from Friday's close of $250.
With a bear case of $220 a share and a bull case of $410, the firm sees a 3:1 risk-reward ratio.

"In a market of see-sawing AI leaders and laggards, we detail 5 catalysts ahead to re-rate shares and drive material outperformance," analyst Brian Nowak, who kept his Overweight rating, wrote in a note Sunday.
5 catalysts for Amazon - Faster AWS growth: Morgan Stanley now expects revenue at AWS, Amazon's cloud unit, to grow 47% in 2027 and 42% in 2028, up from 41% and 37%.
The change follows Nvidia's (NVDA) disclosure that it expects AWS to buy and deploy about 2 million of its GPUs over those two years.
The extra chips also lift the firm's capital spending forecast for Amazon to $355 billion in 2027 and $365 billion in 2028.
- Bigger AWS profits: Nowak expects AWS operating margins of 42% in 2027 and 44% in 2028, which supports about $16.50 in Amazon earnings per share in 2028.

itens.titulo: Xnode Launches Cortx Sentinel to Control AI Agent Actions; Xnode Cortx Now Available on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud Marketplaces
itens.descricao: Xnode Launches Cortx Sentinel to Control AI Agent Actions; Xnode Cortx Now Available on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud Marketplaces Yahoo Finance
trechos: LAS VEGAS, October 19, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Xnode today announced Cortx Sentinel, a new capability of the Xnode Cortx AI Control Plane that checks AI agent actions before they run.
Xnode Cortx customers include a global trading technology firm connected to more than 900 exchanges, an investment firm with more than $3 billion in assets under management, and a large US city.
Since August, licensed users at its largest deployment have grown 50%, and monthly token volume, now in the billions, rises every month.
A $48,000 payment from an agent with a $25,000 limit is held until a second person approves it, and the decision goes into a signed record auditors can verify independently.
"Banks want to use agents, but the first thing their risk teams ask is what happens when one goes wrong," said Kumar Velugula, Xnode Founder and CEO.
"With Cortx Sentinel, a bank can stop a bad payment before it goes out and show its examiners what happened.
And it can start with the cloud account it already has." AIMultiple ranked Xnode Cortx highest among 12 AI Control Plane vendors it evaluated.
Xnode holds ISO 27001 certification and a SOC 2 Type 2 report.
